news.headline: FDA grants RMAT designation to Scancell's melanoma DNA vaccine
news.summary: iSCIB1+ (inzitagene plasmivec) for advanced melanoma gets Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy status; Phase 3 expected to start December 2026 — investigational, not available to patients.
news.source: Scancell release via GlobeNewswire / Manila Times

news.headline: Tumor protein patterns may predict who responds to melanoma immunotherapy
news.summary: Mount Sinai + NCI CPTAC studies (207 patients) found three pre-treatment protein signatures tied to outcomes on anti-PD-1 + anti-CTLA-4 — early, association-only.
